impact.derivation: 239 sessions matched the cohort over 11 days (4.2% of this tenant's traffic in the window). Observed resolution 0.314 against a baseline of 0.816 (this cohort has no before-period, so the baseline is other question-answering intents on the same agent in the same window), so 120 conversations that would have resolved did not. 149 ended in a handoff the agent was not built to make; 15 were abandoned. cost_usd is the sum over the cohort and covers v3 traffic only.

findings.if_nothing_changes: At the observed rate this costs about 11 unresolved conversations a day in this cohort, and 62% of them reach a human who was not meant to be involved. The product line is new, so these are first impressions of it.

findings.not_a_regression_because: aggregate containment rises 2.8pt in this window purely because branch_locator's share of traffic goes from 13% to 44%. Every per-intent cohort is flat within noise. This is a mix shift, not a quality change in either direction.
evidence: no config change on acme-bank in the window

findings.not_a_regression_because: the drop is simultaneous across BOTH tenants, every intent and every channel, and coincides exactly with the judge quality_rubric v1 -> v2 change on day 28. We measured the rubric, not the agent. Quality is only trended within a judge_version from here on.

findings.not_a_regression_because: Volume is 3.5x baseline for four days and tool p95 latency doubles, but resolution and judged quality are flat and both recover the moment volume does. This is a load event for the platform view, not a quality regression.

gaps.why: No failover mechanism exists in the runtime, so no failover event is ever emitted. There is nothing in the corpus that records a primary path failing and an alternate being chosen, because that choice is never made.
gaps.why_the_proxy_misleads: those are QUALITY retries — the same target re-issued after a malformed response — not a switch to an alternate target. Reporting them as failover would show a small non-zero rate that reads as 'failover is working', when the truth is that failover does not exist. A chart here would be worse than no chart.

gaps.why: Cost per resolved conversation is only computable for v3 traffic — cost_usd lives on llm_call steps, which v2_flow sessions do not emit. On acme-bank that is 27.5% of conversations with no cost attached. We report the v3 figure with the denominator stated rather than a blended number that silently treats a quarter of traffic as free.
